target: For a complex Toeplitz matrix T of size n+1, prove uniqueness of positive unit-circle atomic data in the singular case rank(T)<=n: two rank-sized representations have equal finite supports and equal weights on that support. Also prove fixed-support weight recovery for support size <=n+1, and an explicit full-rank one-by-one counterexample to unconditional uniqueness. Do not claim nonuniqueness for every full-rank matrix without a separate proof.
conventions: Same full Hermitian two-sided Toeplitz convention T_ij=sum w(z)*conj(z^i)*z^j; finite distinct-node supports, strictly positive real weights; weight functions compared only on support, or after zero extension. Ordinary ascending coefficients and degree<=n for kernel polynomials.
DH_analogue: Identical finite linear-algebra uniqueness and counterexample statements for any DH-derived matrix satisfying the premises. No arithmetic PSD estimate or separator.
